name: 匈牙利卡
summary: 面向具有适用高等专业资格，并依据合资格雇佣或公司工作安排在匈牙利工作的第三国公民。
summaryEn: For third-country nationals with applicable higher professional qualifications working in Hungary under qualifying employment or company arrangements.

jobOffer.summary: 须有符合该路径要求的工作邀请、合同或雇主安排。
jobOffer.summaryEn: A job offer, contract or employer arrangement meeting the route rules is required.

qualification.summary: 须满足该高技能路径适用的教育、培训、经验或专业认可条件。
qualification.summaryEn: The education, training, experience or recognition rules for this skilled route must be met.

assessment.summary: 须通过申请时适用的国籍、行业、工资、招聘、劳动力市场或其他主管机关审查。
assessment.summaryEn: Any nationality, sector, salary, recruitment, labour-market or other authority assessment in force when applying must be met.

disclaimer: 本资料仅供一般教育用途，不构成个性化移民或法律建议。
